messages:
Maya R: starting the cross-service deploy window now. plan: pin shared-schema -> v2.14.1; runtime 3.3.0 rollout; api 5.10.0 -> 5.11.0 (minor); router 2.9.5 -> 2.10.0. console will stay at 1.8.0 for compatibility. canary wave = eu-west-1 first (10% traffic), then global ramp if green.

 deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by @Maya R. ID: deploy-3798765432-wave1. Canary: eu-west-1 at 22:00 UTC. To abort: `/deploy abort deploy-3798765432-wave1`.

 Alex R: rollback criteria? need clear SLO triggers and error-budget guardrails.

 Sanjay P: suggested thresholds:
 - 5xx rate > 0.8% sustained over 2m
 - p95 latency increase > 40% vs baseline for API
 - runtime OOM rate > 0.1% or KV cache miss spike
 If any hit, abort canary and pin to previous versions.

 Priya K: agree. add per-route error thresholds for model-serving endpoints ( /v1/generate, /v1/chat ). If chat error rate > 1% for 3m, rollback.

 Kim (prod ops): canary region note — router healthfeed shows route-level 503s during previous pin. Recommendation: enable router fallback to legacy-shard for the first 30m of canary. Command:
 ```
 routerctl set-fallback --target legacy-shard --duration 30m --scope canary-deploy-3798765432
 ```

 Maya R: noted. will set fallback before wave1.

 Alex R: release notes checklist:
 - schema change summary
 - backward-compatibility notes for console
 - known issues & mitigation steps (router fallback + how to abort)
 - rollout timeline + contact oncall list
 Priya K: I'll draft and post to #release-notes. tagging @oncall.

 Sanjay P: also add metrics to monitor in datadog dashboard: api.p95, api.5xx_rate, runtime.memory.oom, router.route.503.

 Maya R: performing dry-run smoke in staging now. will post quick results in 15m. if staging passes, kick canary at 22:00 UTC.

 deploy-bot: Dry-run completed OK (smoke tests green). Ready to proceed. To start: `/deploy start deploy-3798765432-wave1`.

 Kim (prod ops): copying rollout playbook here — if canary aborts, immediate steps:
 1) `/deploy abort <id>`
 2) pin shared-schema back: `schemactl pin v2.14.0`
 3) rollback runtime pods to 3.2.0
 4) open incident channel and notify infra oncall

 Alex R: one more: add a short canary-specific A/B prompt set to catch regression in generation quality (redwood-eval: canary-vs-prod, 50 prompts). If quality drops > 5% in eval metric, abort.

 Maya R: good call. kicking off eval run now.

 Priya K: I'll post release notes + rollback doc 30m before canary.

 Maya R: thanks everyone. ping here once wave1 starts or if any anomalies. :thumbsup:
